node.window.what: Open one node's own window, the thing people put on a second monitor.

params.name: tab
params.what: which tab to open on; the window's default when absent

node.window.answers: `tab` is the tab the window actually opened on, which is not always the one asked for. Refused outright in a headless session, there being no window to open one beside.

example.what: put one node on a second monitor
